description: Forward cases for proactive public claim-evidence auditing.

cases.input: At commit `abc1234`, five workflow-equivalent commands measured a `5.39` point coverage increase and `6` statements remaining to the target. All tests pass.
cases.recommended_revision: At commit `abc1234`, five workflow-equivalent commands measured a `5.39` point coverage increase and `6` statements remaining to the target. The available evidence does not establish that all tests pass at the current head.
cases.rationale: Preserve the measured coverage evidence while removing a broader current-head test claim that the cited commands do not establish.

cases.input: The serial regression passes at `abc1234`, so this guarantees correct behavior in serial and parallel.
cases.recommended_revision: The serial regression passes at `abc1234`; parallel behavior has not been verified.
must_remove: guarantees correct behavior in serial and parallel
cases.rationale: A serial test supports only the serial path; narrow the publication text before a reviewer has to challenge the guarantee.

cases.input: At head `d4e5f60`, `pytest tests/test_parser.py -q` reports `18 passed`; this covers the three documented parser fixtures and does not exercise network input.
cases.recommended_revision: At head `d4e5f60`, `pytest tests/test_parser.py -q` reports `18 passed`; this covers the three documented parser fixtures and does not exercise network input.
cases.rationale: The claim is already tied to a current head, literal command, raw result, bounded scope, and exclusion.
